newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss sight deposits rise to 3,602.2 million Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss sight deposits rise to 3,602.2 million Sfr.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank said sight deposits rose by 416.2 million Swiss francs to 3.60 billion in the reporting period ended May 9.
Statement of May 12 in millions of Swiss francs:

Borrowing at the emergency Lombard window fell by 344.2 million francs to 1.5 million in the reporting period. Outstanding borrowing via the discount facility and swaps of money market certificates rose by 1,350.7 million francs to 1,996.0 million.
An SNB spokesman said that no monetary conclusions could be drawn from the latest figures.
"You cannot deduce any monetarily interesting things from such changes," he said in repsonse to an enquiry. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
